en: A black-and-white postcard image depicting a steamship named 'PHOEBUS' docked in a European city harbor. The vessel features typical early-to-mid 20th century design, with a smokestack emitting steam. In the background are distinct European residential or warehouse buildings with steep roofs and regularly spaced windows. A quay with docking platforms is visible in the foreground.
